description: Write a file, refusing the write when it changed underneath since the editor::open it started from. On refusal the divergence comes back as a patch.

content.description: Full new contents. This is a whole-file write, not a patch.

expected_mtime.description: `mtime` from the `editor::open` this edit started from (1s resolution). A mismatch refuses the write and returns the divergence as a patch.

expected_version.description: `version` from the `editor::open` or `editor::save` this edit started from. When present it is the guard and `expected_mtime` is ignored.

added.description: Lines this save added relative to what was on disk before it.

conflict.description: True when the write was refused because the file changed underneath.

conflict_patch.description: On conflict: a unified diff from the current disk contents to the contents you tried to write, so the divergence is reviewable without a second round trip.

created.description: True when the file did not exist and was created.

disk_mtime.description: What was on disk when a conflict was detected.

disk_version.description: Version of the disk contents when a conflict was detected — the value to send as `expected_version` once you have reconciled with them.

mtime.description: Last-modified time after the write. Feed it into the next save.

saved.description: True when the file was written.

version.description: Version of the content this file now holds: what was written on success, what is on disk on a conflict. Feed it into the next save as `expected_version`.
